# Part VIII: Network Analytics {.unnumbered}

Fraud is rarely the work of one person. Vendors who share a bank account, employees who share an address with a supplier, firms that trade in circles: these are relationships, and they are best seen as a network. This part introduces graphs in R and applies them to finding related parties, rings and collusion.

The chapters in this part are:

- @sec-graph, nodes, edges, components and paths, with igraph.
- @sec-netaudit, rings of shared identities, agents, and circular trading, with interactive networks.
